title: Swirling Aura/Skill history
wikitext:
{{Skill history}}

== [[Feedback:Game updates/20120913|September 13, 2012]] ==
* Reduced recharge to 15 seconds.
* Changed functionality to: "For 5 seconds, you are enchanted with Swirling Aura and have +1...6 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block projectiles. If you are Overcast when you cast this spell, all party members in earshot are also enchanted."
